summary: Held policy changes show as needing approval, and managed tenants run without secrets and report removals before making them.

fixes.title: Held policy changes show as needing approval
fixes.text: A run stopped by the policy mass-change safety check now shows amber as needs approval on Jobs and Home, never as failed, and raises an alert.

fixes.title: Admin settings reach managed tenants unchanged
fixes.text: Settings such as create TAP and provisioning dates now travel with each admin to managed tenants exactly as the managing tenant set them.

fixes.title: Managed tenant pull runs without a secret
fixes.text: A managed tenant's scheduled pull now runs as its own managed identity, with the permissions it needs.
fixes.action: Re-deploy the pull job for each managed tenant without an engine secret to move it onto its own identity.

fixes.title: Removals are reported before they happen
fixes.text: Admins that stop reaching a managed tenant are reported as would remove, and removed only when you allow it, within the removal limit.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The weekly read-link renewal signs in with certificates only, joining the database admin group waits for the directory, and re-deploying the pull job works again.
